annotations.title: Check if an article is still good law

description: STILL-GOOD-LAW CHECK — is this article still in force, when was it last amended, what amended it, and how many of the decisions interpreting it cite a version older than that amendment. Short and cheap ON PURPOSE: run it before citing an article, every time. A decision reasoning about a superseded version may no longer support the point you are citing it for. Use get_related instead when you want the full neighbourhood.

law.description: The act, however it is at hand: a citation ('Legea 265/2022', 'HG 1/2016', 'Ordinul 2594/C/2008'), a common name ('Codul fiscal'), a title any tool printed, or 'normele de aplicare a Legii X'.

name: check_status
